findings.fix: Shift features backward (positive periods) instead. For a label, keep the shift and add '# lookahead-lint: ignore[LA001]' so the intent stays visible in review.
findings.message: negative shift pulls future rows into the present; legitimate only for label construction, which should be suppressed inline [periods=-1]
findings.name: negative-shift
findings.rationale: A negative shift reads values that are not observable at the row's timestamp.

findings.fix: Pass shuffle=False for ordered data, or split on an explicit date boundary.
findings.message: train_test_split is not pinned to shuffle=False, so future rows enter training
findings.name: shuffled-split
findings.rationale: Random splits of a time-ordered frame place later rows before earlier ones.

findings.fix: Use forward fill (.ffill(), method='ffill', limit_direction='forward') so gaps are filled only from already-observed values.
findings.message: backward fill propagates a later observation onto an earlier timestamp [bfill()]
findings.name: backward-fill
findings.rationale: Filling backward copies data from the future into rows that predate it.
